description: An aggregated change set passed to IModelingModelWriter.SaveChangesAsync: ModelId, ProviderKey, BaseVersion = Metadata.SourceVersion, content changes of existing items (Elements, Relationships) and the additive v2 batch — AddedElements/AddedRelationships, RemovedElementIds/RemovedRelationshipIds and ViewChanges (layout). A null member always means unchanged; the batch is applied atomically in the contract's fixed order (decision MODELING-AUTHORING-CHANGESET).
